create_monolingual_dataset: create a MonolingualDataset wrapper for monolingual data with source and target vocabularies
collate_samples: collate a list of monolingual samples into a mini-batch with padded source and target tensors
make_source_target: build source and target tensors from future and past shifted tokens for language modeling
filter_vocab: filter target tokens to replace out-of-vocabulary indices with the unknown token
ordered_indices: generate an ordered list of indices for batching with optional shuffling by sample size
